title: Former FBI cyber chief says he double promoted Brett Leatherman

data.claim: Former FBI Cyber Division Outreach Section chief John Riggi said he selected Leatherman over candidates with more tenure, double promoted him and predicted he would eventually run the Cyber Division.

inferences: The statement documents unusually strong internal sponsorship and creates patronage or favoritism optics.
caveats: Riggi said the selection was based on expertise, leadership and communication skills.
The statement does not prove a merit-system violation or corruption.
